name: Stanozolol

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A 17-alpha-alkylated anabolic-androgenic steroid formerly approved in the United States for hereditary angioedema. The US human product has been discontinued; it remains a Schedule III controlled substance and is prohibited in sport.

systems.note: Androgen receptor agonism; the intended anabolic target.
Sought for lean mass without the fluid retention of aromatising androgens.
17-alpha-alkylation confers direct hepatotoxicity, well documented for this compound.

monitors.why: 17-alpha-alkylated structure with a documented cholestatic injury pattern.
Cholestatic injury is the characteristic pattern.
Separates a hepatobiliary ALP rise from a bone one.
Documents suppression of the endogenous axis.
